actions.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent desktop-pet animation SPRITE SHEET. Create ONE 2x2 sprite sheet with EXACTLY FOUR separate full-body animation frames in reading order on a truly transparent RGBA background. Every equal square cell contains exactly one complete character, clear 10% transparent padding on all sides including fruit and feet; no grid lines, no text, numbers or labels. The attached approved image is the ONLY CHARACTER IDENTITY/style reference: preserve exactly the very round plush yellow Lulu, huge broad orange muzzle, blue-gray glossy eyes, round small ears, orange shorts-like lower body, tiny orange feet, and one orange/tangerine fruit with green stem on head. Soft 3D plush render with same proportions/color/material. Same fixed camera, full body framing and physical scale in all four frames. Frames must depict separately articulated poses with true local body-part/expression changes, not translating/scaling/rotating the entire sprite. Natural loop progression. No cut-off limbs, no extra arms/legs, no shadow, no floor, no reflections, no floating props, no opaque/checkerboard background. Each cell stays independent, sprites never overlap cell boundaries. Front-facing bashful hands-clasped pose from the reference: both little paws meet just below the orange muzzle over the belly. Frame1 paws close together at belly, frame2 fingers gently clasped, frame3 one hand rubs over the other and chin dips slightly, frame4 returns toward frame1 with a bashful blink. Small genuine arm articulation, no detached hands.

corrections.loaf: Use case: background-extraction. Edit this exact 2x2 sprite sheet: REMOVE ALL BACKGROUND, yellow aura, glow, haze, floor, shadow and reflection. Preserve the four yellow-orange plush Lulu belly-down loaf poses, their orange fruit, paws, feet, eyes and expressions exactly. Deliver a TRUE transparent RGBA PNG, with alpha zero for all space outside the solid character outline. No black or white canvas, no checkerboard texture, no replacement background. Crisp softly antialiased character edges, absolutely no surrounding light halo. Keep all four complete characters inside their separate equal cells with transparent margins, no resizing one pose differently from another. The image must be usable directly as game sprites on arbitrary desktop backgrounds.
